title: biomes.rivers/1
description: data/biomes/rivers.json: planet generation 2's rivers (docs/world/rivers.md; WorldRivers). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. Order checks are WorldRivers' own load and rivers_check.

enabled.description: Rivers on or off; off, nothing in WorldRivers runs and a planet is as it was.

dry.description: Moisture under which a land cell sheds no runoff.

gain.description: Runoff per unit of moisture over dry.

frozenT.description: Under this temperature a cell sheds none (a frozen river is not a channel).

river.description: A cell whose flow passes this is a river cell.

ref.description: The flow a river of the base width carries.

maxCols.description: The widest (at least minCols: WorldRivers' load).

width1.description: Columns added with the square root of flow over ref.

depth0.description: Depth at no flow, in units.

depth1.description: Depth added with the square root of flow over ref.

maxDepth.description: The deepest a river is: under the depth that hides a fighter (WorldRivers' load).

freeboard.description: How far the surface lies under the lower bank.

reach.description: Columns either side the crossing is snapped to the lowest ground within.

bank.description: Columns outside the channel the banks are read at.

margin.description: Columns kept clear of a settlement.

floor.description: No river on ground under this height (the sea's edge).

spacing.description: How many rivers a ring keeps.

gapUnits.description: Of the crossings at most one is kept in any this many units (Game Design 23b row 13: 3,000).

maxPerRing.description: At most this many a ring.

refuse.description: Fine biomes a river does not cross (their names are checked by WorldRivers' load).
